title: Affine calculation of fibres of a finite pushforward
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $B$ be a finite $A$-algebra, let $V=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and $X=\operatorname{Spec}(B)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $s\in V$ have residue field $\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. For the induced finite morphism $f:X\to V$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], the canonical map $(f_*\mathcal O_X)_s\otimes_{\mathcal O_{V,s}}\kappa(s)\to\Gamma(X\times_V\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s),\mathcal O)$ is an isomorphism, identified under the affine descriptions with $B\otimes_A\kappa(s)\cong B\otimes_A A_s/\mathfrak m_sA_s$ [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra].

proof.text: Apply the already proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.exists_ringEquiv_stalk_tensorProduct_fiber with A, B and p. Its two ring equivalences and four generator compatibility clauses are definitionally the required ones. The source theorem holds for arbitrary A-algebras, so the retained finite-module hypothesis is unused. Its proof identifies the affine fibre sections as a ring pushout and the pushforward stalk as a localization, then uses tensor base change; no separate tilde-module lemmas are needed here.

lean.statement: theorem Spec.exists_ringEquiv_stalk_tensorProduct_fiber (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (p : Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) : letI φ := CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B) letI f := Spec.map φ letI R := (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).presheaf.stalk p letI P := (Spec.topMap φ _* (Spec.structureSheaf (CommRingCat.of B)).1).stalk p letI K := (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).residueField p letI : Algebra R P := ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat p).map (Spec.sheafedSpaceMap φ).hom.c).hom.toAlgebra letI : Algebra R K := ((Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).residue p).hom.toAlgebra letI : Algebra A K := (StructureSheaf.toStalk (CommRingCat.of A) p ≫ (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).residue p).hom.toAlgebra ∃ (e : P ⊗[R] K ≃+* Γ(f.fiber p, ⊤)) (g : B ⊗[A] K ≃+* Γ(f.fiber p, ⊤)), (∀ b : B, e ((StructureSheaf.toPushforwardStalk φ p).hom b ⊗ₜ 1) = g (b ⊗ₜ 1)) ∧ (∀ k : K, e (1 ⊗ₜ k) = g (1 ⊗ₜ k)) ∧ (∀ b : B, g (b ⊗ₜ 1) = (f.fiberι p).appTop.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).inv.hom b)) ∧ (∀ k : K, g (1 ⊗ₜ k) = (f.fiberToSpecResidueField p).appTop.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso K).inv.hom k))
